description: An open source Firebase alternative providing a full Postgres database, authentication, instant APIs, and storage.
auth_notes: Uses project API keys (anon/service_role), JWT tokens for user sessions, and OAuth2/OIDC/SSO for identity providers.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up instantly on the website and create free projects with API keys available on a self-serve basis.
api_notes: Covers auto-generated REST/GraphQL data APIs, auth, storage, edge functions, realtime subscriptions, and platform management.
mcp_notes: Supabase provides official toolsets and support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
rationale: Supabase provides broad, fully documented APIs and self-serve free credentials, making it immediately buildable as an agent toolkit.

evidence.note: Describes Supabase Auth mechanisms, JWT tokens, and OAuth support.
Outlines the Free Plan and self-serve project tier details.
Details auto-generated REST and GraphQL data APIs.
References MCP integration under developer AI tools and documentation.
